title: Composite SLO: embedding-similarity quality + P99 latency with tiered enterprise SLA and release guards
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Background: Enterprise customers ingest embeddings as a core building block for search and recommendations. Recent incidents showed low-latency targets being met while embedding vector similarity degraded after a quantized model rollout. Problem: Current SLOs are siloed (latency-only or availability-only). We need a composite SLO that simultaneously enforces latency and an objective embedding-quality metric so rollouts cannot trade quality for latency. This ticket defines requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout gates, and monitoring for a Composite SLO that combines P99 latency and a normalized embedding-similarity score with tiered SLA bands for enterprise customers.
goals: Define a composable SLO that weights P99 latency and embedding similarity into a single actionable metric
Establish per-customer SLA tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze) with explicit error budgets and contractual escalation thresholds
Specify automated rollout gates (shadowing, canary on synthetic corpora, quality regression thresholds, burn-rate checks) to prevent quality regressions
Create acceptance criteria, dashboards, and alerting rules to operationalize the composite SLO
Document rollback/runbook and postmortem criteria tied to composite SLO breaches
non_goals: Designing new embedding training or model architectures (outside scope)
proposal_summary: Introduce a composite SLO score S = w_q * Q_norm + w_l * L_norm where Q_norm is a normalized embedding-quality metric derived from a daily synthetic probe set (higher is better), L_norm is a normalized latency metric (higher is better when latency is low), and w_q/w_l are weights adjustable per SLA tier. Define monitoring, alerting, and an automated rollout workflow that must satisfy both quality and latency thresholds before traffic ramp.
composite_slo_spec: Metric Q: embedding-similarity normalized to 0..1. Calculated daily from a stable set of 1,200 synthetic prompts and reference vectors using mean reciprocal rank (MRR) and cosine similarity aggregation. Baseline Q_baseline computed from current GA model over trailing 14 days.
Metric L: P99 latency normalized to 0..1 using L_norm = max(0, 1 - (P99_ms - target_ms)/target_ms_window). Window = 2x target_ms.
Composite score S = w_q * (Q / Q_baseline) + w_l * L_norm. Default weights: Gold: w_q=0.7 w_l=0.3; Silver: w_q=0.5 w_l=0.5; Bronze: w_q=0.3 w_l=0.7.
SLO target: Maintain S >= 0.95 for Gold, >= 0.90 for Silver, >= 0.85 for Bronze over a rolling 7-day window.
Error budget: 5% of minutes per 30-day window for Gold where S < target; breach => contractual escalation and potential financial SLA credits per agreement
rollout_guards_and_workflow: Pre-rollout checks: run synthetic probe on canary model with full production config. Must pass Q >= 0.995 * Q_baseline AND P99 <= target_ms * 1.1 on canary traffic before 1% traffic ramp.

Shadowing: 48h shadowing for at least two enterprise customers representative corpora. Compare H1: live model vs canary for Q_regression (difference in normalized Q per customer). Allowed per-customer drop: Gold <= 0.5% absolute, Silver <= 1.0%, Bronze <= 2.0%.
Canary ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 30m minimum per step and composite S stability checks. Automated rollback if S drops below inter-step threshold or burn-rate > 1.5x.

Automated gating: if composite S drops by >1.5% from baseline during a ramp step or burn-rate exceeds configured limits, hold ramp and trigger incident runbook. Manual approval required to continue after investigation.
Fallback policy: immediate automatic re-route to previous GA variant for affected customers if S breaches Gold SLA by >2% for more than 10 minutes or if P99 increases by >50%.
Post-rollout validation: 7-day guarded period where S is monitored at customer and global level. Any customer-specific regression triggers targeted rollback for that customer.
Contractual escalation: prepare templated notifications for customers when error budget consumption exceeds thresholds (25%, 50%, 90%).
acceptance_criteria: SLO definition doc published and reviewed by ENG/RESEARCH/SALES/LEGAL
Dashboard with Composite S, Q (raw and normalized), and L (P99) per customer and global is available in Console with 1-minute granularity
Synthetic probe harness implemented and versioned; baseline computation automated and auditable
Automated canary gating implemented in CI/CD with the specified checks and rollback hooks
Alerting runbooks for S breaches created and validated via a tabletop exercise
Demo: perform a staged canary with synthetic dataset and show automatic hold/rollback when quality threshold is violated
Legal & Sales sign-off on contractual SLA language and credits for Gold tier
monitoring_and_alerting: Primary alert: Composite S drops below SLA target for a customer tier for >5 minutes -> SEV2 page + Slack channel
Secondary alert: Composite S trending down with 15m burn-rate > 1.2x -> Ops dashboard annotation and POC paging
Immediate page: P99 exceeds 2x target_ms or Q_norm < 0.9 * Q_baseline for Gold customers
Daily error-budget report emailed to account owners when consumption > 10%
Retention: 90 days for composite S timeseries, 365 days for daily baselines and synthetic probe outputs
runbook_and_playbook: Triage: validate alert, confirm scope (global vs customer-specific), check canary/rollback status
Mitigation: trigger automatic routing to previous GA variant if configured; if not available, scale up dedicated capacity as temporary mitigation
Post-incident: run targeted embedding regression tests, capture failing synth inputs, open ENG investigation ticket with priority P0 for Gold regressions
Communication: customer-facing template for acknowledgement and remediation plan; include ETA for rollback or next steps
Postmortem criteria: any Gold SLA credit event must result in a blameless postmortem within 3 business days
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Synthetic probe may not capture real-customer distribution -> Mitigate: require at least two representative customer corpora in shadowing
Risk: Normalization drift in Q_baseline over time -> Mitigate: rolling 14-day baseline with anomaly detection and manual review
Risk: High false positive alerts due to transient network noise -> Mitigate: use smoothing and require sustained breaches (>5m) before page
Risk: Added complexity in SLO may confuse sales/legal -> Mitigate: create simple SLA cheat-sheets per tier and include worked examples
notes_and_links: Existing SLO ref: PM-21001 (baseline latency envelopes)
